title: Total official development assistance grants that focus on poverty reduction as a share of the recipient country’s gross national income
graph_title: Official development assistance for poverty reduction (percentage of GNI)
national_indicator_available: Official development assistance for poverty reduction (percentage of GNI)
national_indicator_description: This indicator measures total official development assistance disbursements, including both grants and loans, that contribute to the defined poverty reduction sectors of social protection, health, education, and water and sanitation, as a percentage of the gross national income.
computation_definitions: In order to match the global definitions as closely as possible, poverty reduction items have been defined as including social protection, health, education, and water and sanitation. In the original data source, figures for official development assistance disbursements are provided in United States Dollars (USD) while figures for gross national income are provided in Rwandan Francs (FRW). Gross national income was converted to USD using the yearly average exchange rate provided in the same data source before calculating the indicator.
computation_calculations: Sum of disbursements in social protection, health, education, and water and sanitation sectors in USD / Gross national income in USD * 100
comments_limitations: The selected sectors may not align exactly with the global definitions of poverty reduction items due to differences in data aggregation. Across the reporting period, the selected sectors generally represent approximately 40-50% of total official development assistance. This indicator is calculated using figures for total official development assistance disbursements, including both grants and loans. Rounded figures are used due to availability. Data sources for 2009 to 2013 do not specify exact figures for all sectors, so approximate figures are used based on text and graphs available in the data source.
indicator_name: Total official development assistance grants from all donors that focus on poverty reduction as a share of the recipient country’s gross national income
target_name: Ensure significant mobilization of resources from a variety of sources, including through enhanced development cooperation, in order to provide adequate and predictable means for developing countries, in particular least developed countries, to implement programmes and policies to end poverty in all its dimensions
indicator_definition: Total official development assistance (ODA) grants from all donors that focus on poverty reduction as a share of the recipient country’s gross national income. Poverty reduction items can be defined as ODA to basic social services (basic health, basic education, basic water and sanitation, population programmes and reproductive health) and developmental food aid (see DAC/CRS codes [here](https://webfs.oecd.org/oda/DataCollection/Resources/)).

source_other_info_1: This is the source for the numerator (official development assistance disbursements by sector). The [External Development Finance Report - 2021/2022 Fiscal Year](https://www.devpartners.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/devpartners/Reports/ODA/EDFR_2021-22_Final_After_Design.pdf) is used for figures from 2016/17 to 2021/22. Individual year reports are used for earlier figures, namely [Rwanda Official Development Assistance Report - An Extended Review 2015/2016 Fiscal Year](https://www.devpartners.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/devpartners/Reports/ODA/ODA_report_201516__2_.pdf); [Official Development Assistance Report - FY 2013-2014 Aid for Development](https://www.devpartners.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/devpartners/Reports/ODA/ODA_Report_FY_2013-2014.pdf); [Official Development Assistance Report - FY 2012-2013 Aid for Development](https://www.devpartners.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/devpartners/Reports/ODA/ODA_2012-2013.pdf); [Official Development Assistance Report - FY 2011-2012 Aid for Development](https://www.devpartners.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/devpartners/Reports/ODA/ODA_Report_2011-2012_2_.pdf); [Official Development Assistance Report - FY 2010/2011](https://www.devpartners.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/devpartners/Reports/ODA/ODA_Report_2010-2011.pdf); and [Official Development Assistance (ODA) Report (Inaugural Edition) - FY 2009/2010](https://www.devpartners.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/devpartners/Reports/ODA/Inaugural_ODA_Report__FY_2009-10___1_.pdf).
